paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesikta deRav Kahana 173b: Rabbi Nechemyah of Jaffa asked before Rabbi Tanchum bar Chama in the name of Rabbi Sima.

notes.text: The Pesikta deRav Kahana locator 173b and the transmission involving Rabbi Nechemyah of Jaffa, Rabbi Tanchum bar Chama and Rabbi Sima remain unverified in the returned evidence. No particular printed pagination or edition is established.

The folio left open in the preceding note is verified in Buber’s 1868 Pesikta deRav Kahana. Folio 173b, in Aharei Mot, gives the chain quoted here. In the parallel passage, Mandelbaum’s Pesikta 26:9 instead has Rabbi Nachman of Jaffa ask Rabbi Pinchas bar Chama in the name of Rabbi Simon. Vayikra Rabbah 20:10 names Rabbi Yudan of Jaffa, Rabbi Pinchas bar Rabbi Chama, and Rabbi Simon.
